case.title: The Cruise Ship Mystery
case.introduction: Tonight at The Aurora Voyager, the swap of a famous painting with a fake one has turned the evening upside down. No one is allowed to leave. 4 guests are still here, and each one is hiding something. One of them is not who they say they are. Find that person.
case.crime: The swap of a famous painting with a fake one
case.target_fake_identity: Rowan Bianchi, a art expert people trust
case.escape_plan: Rowan Bianchi plans to sneak out while everyone is confused, and be gone before the police arrive.

rooms.name: The Grand Lobby
rooms.description: A huge hall with stone floors and a wide staircase.

rooms.name: The Lounge
rooms.description: Soft yellow light, leather chairs, and slow music playing.

rooms.name: The Dining Room
rooms.description: A long table, still set for dinner.

rooms.name: The Private Study
rooms.description: Book shelves, a heavy desk, and one locked drawer.

rooms.name: The Terrace Garden
rooms.description: Cool night air, tall bushes, and a view of the water.

rooms.name: The Guest Rooms
rooms.description: A hallway of numbered doors. Most are half open.

characters.name: Priya Sinclair
characters.personality: smiles a lot, but always planning

characters.secret: Priya is using a false name, but for a different reason.
characters.goal: Priya wants to leave before anyone finds out the truth.
characters.alibi: Says they were in The Grand Lobby when it happened.
knowledge: Saw Rowan Bianchi acting strange near The Private Study.
Heard an angry argument earlier that night.
lies: Hides one thing: Priya owes a lot of money from betting.

characters.name: Rowan Bianchi
characters.background: A art expert with a messy past.
characters.secret: Rowan saw something that night and has not told anyone.
characters.goal: Rowan wants to look helpful while hiding a secret.
characters.alibi: Says they were in The Guest Rooms when it happened.

lies: Says they never went into the room where the main clue was found.
Says all their papers are real.

timeline.description: The crime happens: the swap of a famous painting with a fake one.
The alarm goes off. No one may leave.
Rowan Bianchi is seen moving toward a side door.

evidence.name: a cheap phone
evidence.description: A cheap phone with only one number called.

evidence.name: a torn train ticket
evidence.description: A ticket ripped in two. The time on it is earlier than someone said.

evidence.name: a fake passport
evidence.description: It looks real, but the year of birth is a little bit wrong.

evidence.name: a photo
evidence.description: A photo of two guests who say they have never met.

evidence.name: muddy shoes
evidence.description: Costly shoes covered in garden mud, but it has not rained inside.

hidden_clues: Rowan Bianchi's story about where they were does not match the a cheap phone.
Two guests say they have never met, but a photo shows they have.

solution.target_true_identity: A wanted criminal pretending to be a art expert
solution.reasoning: Rowan Bianchi is the hidden person. The main clues (a cheap phone, a torn train ticket) put them at the scene and show their story is not true. Their papers are fake too.

state.current_objective: At The Aurora Voyager tonight, 4 guests are trapped — and one is lying about who they are. Search the rooms, talk to everyone, and find the person behind the swap of a famous painting with a fake one. Some guests lie. Check their stories carefully.

exchanges.question: Where were you at nine?
exchanges.answer: I will tell you what I know, but keep my name out of it.

memory: Detective asked: 'Where were you at nine?'

relationship_notes: The detective searched a room close to me.
